name: OSK Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年OSK Holdings Berhad的Property板块通过子公司收购了两块土地，分别位于Kedah的Bandar Sungai Petani和Selangor的Pekan Country Height，用于未来开发。其他板块在公告中没有披露业务变化。
overview_en: This year, OSK Holdings Berhad's Property segment acquired two parcels of land through subsidiaries, located in Bandar Sungai Petani, Kedah and Pekan Country Height, Selangor, for future development. No business changes were disclosed for other segments in the announcements.

segments.name: 房地产
segments.note: 今年Property板块通过子公司收购土地，以扩大土地储备。
segments.note_en: This year, the Property segment acquired land through subsidiaries to expand its land bank.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接持股99.96%的子公司OSK Properties Sdn. Bhd.与SP Baiduri Sdn. Bhd.签订买卖协议，以RM40,693,552.50收购位于Kedah的Bandar Sungai Petani、Daerah Kuala Muda、Negeri Kedah的40.2公顷永久地契土地。
actions.text_en: Indirect 99.96%-owned subsidiary OSK Properties Sdn. Bhd. entered into a sale and purchase agreement with SP Baiduri Sdn. Bhd. to acquire 40.2 hectares of freehold land in Bandar Sungai Petani, Daerah Kuala Muda, Negeri Kedah for RM40,693,552.50.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接子公司Perspektif Vista Sdn. Bhd.完成收购位于Selangor的Pekan Country Height、Daerah Petaling、Negeri Selangor的土地。
actions.text_en: Indirect subsidiary Perspektif Vista Sdn. Bhd. completed the acquisition of land located in Pekan Country Height, Daerah Petaling, Negeri Selangor.
